items.source: Returns all GenericConverter instances to be registered for the current ConverterBuilder.
items.translation: 返回所有要注册到当前 ConverterBuilder 的 GenericConverter 实例。

items.source: Creates a new ConverterBuilder.ReadingConverterBuilder to produce a converter to read values of the given source (the store type) into the given target (the domain type).
items.translation: 创建一个 ConverterBuilder.ReadingConverterBuilder，用于生成一个转换器，将给定源（存储类型）的值读取到给定目标（领域类型）。

items.source: Creates a new ConverterBuilder.WritingConverterBuilder to produce a converter to write values of the given source (the domain type) into the given target (the store type).
items.translation: 创建一个新ConverterBuilder.WritingConverterBuilder，用于生成一个转换器，将给定源类型（即领域类型）的值写入到给定目标类型（即存储类型）。

items.source: API to easily set up GenericConverter instances using Java 8 lambdas, mostly in bidirectional fashion for easy registration as custom type converters of the Spring Data mapping subsystem. The registration starts either with the definition of a reading or writing converter that can then be completed.
items.translation: 一个 API，可轻松使用 Java 8 Lambda 表达式设置 GenericConverter 实例，主要用于双向转换，以便轻松注册为 Spring Data 映射子系统的自定义类型转换器。注册过程始于定义一个读取或写入转换器，随后可完成该转换器的配置。

items.source: A ConverterBuilder aware of both a reading and writing converter.
items.translation: 一个ConverterBuilder同时知晓读取和写入转换器。

items.source: Interface to represent an intermediate setup step of ConverterBuilder.ConverterAware defining a reading converter first.
items.translation: 接口，用于表示 `ConverterBuilder.ConverterAware` 的中间配置步骤，首先定义读取转换器。

items.source: Interface to represent an intermediate setup step of ConverterBuilder.ConverterAware defining a writing converter first.
items.translation: 接口，用于表示 `ConverterBuilder.ConverterAware` 的中间配置步骤，首先定义写入转换器。
